propositions: git commit --amend -F/-m drops the Change-Id trailer, causing Gerrit to stamp a fresh id and create a duplicate change instead of a patchset
Gerrit's commit-msg hook cannot distinguish an amended -F/-m commit from a new commit, so it cannot preserve the Change-Id at the hook layer
A make amend-msg FILE=<path> wrapper must read HEAD's Change-Id, apply FILE's contents while preserving the existing Change-Id, and fail loudly if HEAD has no Change-Id
AGENTS.md must document make amend-msg as the required path for rewriting a commit message and warn that --amend -m/-F creates duplicate Gerrit changes
No pre-push hook, reflog comparison, or other novel guard should be implemented; the wrapper is the documented default to prevent the failure mode entirely
